name: B10-0445/2025 – After § 78 – Am 9/1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 78a. Calls for the cancellation of the EU’s 2035 end date for the sale of new cars with a combustion engine; suggests, as a policy, more flexibility and pragmatism instead of an abrupt regulatory change in 2035; encourages the automotive industry and suppliers to continue researching and developing all conceivable automotive technologies;
